title.en: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio for watermarking AI-designed proteins
title.zhHans: Google DeepMind 推出用于标记 AI 设计蛋白质的 SynthID Bio

searchSummary.en: Google DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a proof-of-concept family of methods that embeds detectable signatures in AI-designed protein sequences and structures while preserving tested biological function.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 推出 SynthID Bio 概念验证方法系列，在 AI 设计的蛋白质序列与结构中嵌入可检测标记，同时在实验中保持其生物功能。

summary.en: Google DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a proof-of-concept family of methods that embeds detectable signatures in AI-designed protein sequences and structures while preserving tested biological function.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 推出 SynthID Bio 概念验证方法系列，在 AI 设计的蛋白质序列与结构中嵌入可检测标记，同时在实验中保持其生物功能。

narrative.en: Wet-lab tests support the narrow proof of concept, and Nature independently reported the results. The watermark can be removed or obscured through redesign, and no independent follow-on adoption by synthesis providers was established.
narrative.zhHans: 湿实验支持这一有限的概念验证，Nature 也进行了独立报道。但水印可能通过重新设计被移除或掩盖，且尚未证明 DNA 合成机构的独立后续采用。

text.en: Google DeepMind demonstrated biologically functional watermarked protein binders with SynthID Bio.
text.zhHans: Google DeepMind 通过 SynthID Bio 展示了保持生物功能的带水印蛋白质结合物。

text.en: The watermark can be scrubbed or obscured through redesign and remains a proof of concept without established external adoption.
text.zhHans: 水印可通过重新设计被清除或掩盖，目前仍是尚未建立外部采用的概念验证。
